D: A high school kid sneaks out against his dad's orders to go to his best friend's house party.
P: Serve the snacks when the dance-off starts at the party.
S: the snacks on the kitchen bench at Play's house
Wings dried overnight, baked at 220C for 45 minutes until crisp, tossed in hot sauce melted with butter and honey.
the dance battle in the living room
Popcorn tossed in melted butter, smoked paprika and a little garlic salt, served in big paper bags.
the giant sub for the party
A long Italian loaf filled with salami, ham, provolone, lettuce, tomato, onion and Italian dressing, cut into thick slices.
M: ordered when the party gets hungry
Pizza dough stretched thin, sauce, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and left in the box on the bench.
Kid's dad waiting up at home
Meatloaf glazed with tomato and brown sugar, baked at 180C for an hour, with mashed potato, green beans and gravy.
W: the party that runs all night
Chocolate sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fudge frosting and sprinkles, cut into big squares.
K: the punch bowl in the kitchen
Pineapple and orange juice topped with lemonade and lots of ice in a big bowl, sliced oranges floating.

s.note: the snacks on the kitchen bench at Play's house
s.how: Dry 1kg chicken wings overnight and bake at 220C for 45 minutes. Toss in 80ml hot sauce melted with 60g butter and 1 tbsp honey. Serve with celery sticks and 80g blue cheese mashed into a little sour cream.

s.note: the giant sub for the party
s.how: Split a long Italian loaf. Layer with 100g salami, 150g ham, 100g provolone, shredded iceberg, sliced tomato and onion. Drizzle with oil and red wine vinegar and season. Press, then cut into thick slices.

m.note: ordered when the party gets hungry
m.how: Stretch 500g pizza dough into 2 thin bases. Spread with pizza sauce, add 250g mozzarella, 100g pepperoni and dried oregano. Bake on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes, cut into squares and leave in the box on the bench.

w.note: the party that runs all night
w.how: Beat 200g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in a tray at 175C for 30 minutes. Beat 150g butter, 300g icing sugar and 40g cocoa, spread on and cover with sprinkles.

d.note: the punch bowl in the kitchen
d.how: Pour 500ml pineapple juice and 500ml orange juice into a big bowl with lots of ice. Top with 750ml lemonade and float sliced oranges on top. Ladle into cups between dance-offs.
